focus: Design a computer vision system for automated quality inspection in manufacturing that detects defects on production lines, classifies defect types, and integrates with factory automation systems.
action: Capture high-resolution images from production lines
scale: Support model updates without line stoppage
durable: Capture high-resolution images from production lines; Detect surface defects (scratches, dents, cracks)
async: Use object detection models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), Implement anomaly detection with autoencoders for novel defects, Use data augmentation for rare defect types
store: Design a Computer Vision Quality Inspection System
